query:
UPDATE invoices
        SET invoice_date = $2,
            branch_id = $3,
            discount = $4::float8,
            discount_unit = $5,
            payment_status = $6,
            amount_paid = $7::float8,
            advance_amount = $7::float8,
            advance_payment_type = $8,
            customer_id = $9,
            total_price = $10::float8,
            gift_card_redeemed = $11::float8
        WHERE id = $1
